investigation_notes.Description: The PowerShell script performs a storage inventory by recursively scanning C: for files larger than a configurable threshold and exports results to a CSV. Key observations: the script is plaintext (not obfuscated), references DataVault program data paths and log/report files, and is executed by a service account named DataBackupAgent which aligns with backup/agent activity. This matches expected backup inventory behavior and lacks indicators of malicious intent, so it is assessed as Low Priority.
investigation_notes.Script Summary: Recursively enumerates files on C: exceeding a size threshold, logs progress to C:\ProgramData\DataVault\Logs\inventory_scan.log, and exports findings to C:\ProgramData\DataVault\Temp\large_files.csv.
